Gnosis Interpretation
MOVE below 80 is calm, 80-120 is moderate uncertainty, and 150+ is high stress; 103.31 is moderate. SOFR measures secured overnight funding, not unsecured bank funding. NFCI below zero indicates looser-than-average broad financial conditions; -0.496 is the weekly observation for Oct 16, not a live reading. The latest NFCI rose 0.006 from the prior weekly row but remains negative.

Fed & Policy Watch
  • The FOMC meeting is scheduled for Oct 27-28; the Board calendar lists the policy decision Wed Oct 28 at 2:00 PM ET and press conference at 2:30 PM ET, both classified High.
  • Selected Board statistical releases checked against each item's own day list: H.10 today Oct 26 at 4:15 PM; H.6 Tue Oct 27 at 1:00 PM; H.4.1 Thu Oct 29 at 4:30 PM; H.8 Fri Oct 30 at 4:15 PM. Other routine Board releases are not enumerated.
  • BEA schedules third-quarter advance GDP Thu Oct 29 at 8:30 AM ET and September Personal Income and Outlays Nov 4 at 8:30 AM. The New York Fed October calendar separately lists Personal Income and the PCE Deflator Oct 29 at 8:30 AM; this is a material publisher-date conflict, shown separately and unresolved.
  • Chicago Fed confirms CFNAI for Sep on Oct 26 at 8:30 AM and NFCI for week ending Oct 23 on Oct 28 at 8:30 AM. Latest observed NFCI in the returned file remains -0.496 for week ending Oct 16.
Omissions and Watch
  • Calendar coverage is selected, not exhaustive, and limited to checked primary sources. The week-ahead New York Fed calendar has no CPI, PPI or Employment Situation release through Oct 30; the November calendar verifies Employment Situation Nov 6, CPI Nov 10 and PPI Nov 13. The distinct CPI and PPI releases are not conflated.
  • Date/event conflict check: BEA's schedule gives September Personal Income and Outlays on Nov 4, while the New York Fed October calendar lists Personal Income and the PCE Deflator on Oct 29. Both dates are retained with source-specific periods; conflict unresolved. Dallas Fed confirms Texas Retail Outlook Survey results stopped after January 2026, so the stale New York Fed Oct 27 listing is omitted. Census confirms Oct 27 Durable Goods and New Residential Sales dates/periods and the Oct 28 Advance Economic Indicators and Q3 Housing Vacancies releases. Census also lists a preliminary steel imports indicator Oct 27; it is omitted from this selected ES/rates calendar as lower-priority. Richmond Fed's own release page was refused by the available network; its Oct 27 10:00 AM date/time is sourced to the New York Fed calendar only. The Conference Board page request timed out; Consumer Confidence date/time is sourced to the New York Fed calendar, and its period is left unstated.
  • Primary calendar/data pages checked: New York Fed October and November Economic Indicators Calendars; Federal Reserve Board October calendar, FOMC meeting calendar and H.4.1 page; Chicago Fed release calendar and NFCI series; Census 2026 calendar; BEA schedule; Dallas Fed manufacturing and service-sector schedules; TreasuryDirect upcoming auctions; Treasury daily yield curve; New York Fed SOFR; EIA petroleum and natural-gas release schedules; University of Michigan consumer survey. BLS.gov was not requested; BLS release dates/times use the New York Fed calendar.
  • EIA petroleum and natural-gas schedule pages did not provide a verified date-specific release in Oct 26-30, so none is inferred from weekly cadence. Energy watch: WTI is $101.02, down 2.18% from Friday's prior daily bar at the overnight observation; monitor energy-price sensitivity without assuming a release or cause. No separately verified unscheduled policy or geopolitical alert from this run.
  • TreasuryDirect verifies auctions and bid-close times listed above; the 17-Week Bill row has a verified date only and no verified time. No exchange-specific market-structure event or product-hours review was verified. Confirm contract month, exchange hours, liquidity and event updates before execution. Calendar is not a review of unscheduled risks.
Trading Strategy Note | ES Futures
BASE CASE
Treat the 12:20 AM ET ES=F quote as overnight context only: it is a generic continuous quote and Monday's bar is in progress. Friday's SPY close was lower; the early ES quote is modestly above Friday's prior bar, while the official 10Y close rose 4 bp. MOVE at 103.31 remains in the moderate-uncertainty band. CFNAI is scheduled at 8:30 AM, with the FOMC decision/press conference Wed and advance GDP plus a disputed PCE date Thurs. Check live rates, volatility, depth and the selected contract before acting; this is scenario framing, not a directional forecast or trade signal.
INVALIDATION
Reassess if ES sustains a range break without confirmation from live Treasury yields, volatility and market depth; if the selected contract's hours differ; or if official event schedules change. No unsupported levels or targets are supplied. Reconfirm live quotes, auction/event updates and contract details before execution.
